name: Iranshahr-Chabahar Gas Pipeline

values.RouteNotes: Southeastern grid extension from Iranshahr (terminus of IGAT 7, P0446) southward along the Makran corridor to Chabahar and Konarak on the Gulf of Oman coast; built primarily to fuel the Chabahar power plant (switched from liquid fuel to gas). No official GIS route located; endpoints confirmed, corridor approximate.

researcher_notes: NEW ROW. Re-checked match-to-existing: NOT a duplicate. IGAT 7 (P0446) runs Asaluyeh -> Iranshahr and TERMINATES at Iranshahr; this line begins at Iranshahr and extends further south/east to Chabahar+Konarak on the Gulf of Oman coast. Zahedan-Zabol (P6028) is a separate northern SB spur. Add-threshold met: (a) sponsor = National Iranian Gas Co / NIGC, project executed by Iran Gas Engineering & Development Co (IGEDC) under the Oil Ministry; (b) endpoints Iranshahr -> Chabahar, Sistan and Baluchestan, Iran; (c) concrete step = built and inaugurated (well past FID). Status = operating: gas reached Chabahar and the line commenced operation in Persian year 1401 (2022), with formal inauguration of the full system (line + five pressure-boosting stations) attended by the Oil Minister; reported 7 Jun 2024 (Tehran Times). Confirmed data points: LengthKnown = 290 km (Shana, Hamshahri, Mizan all agree). Fuel switch of Chabahar power plant from liquid to gas yields ~USD 560,000/day savings (~USD 200M/yr) per Shana. CONFIDENCE: high, >=2 independent sources agreeing on existence + 290 km + operating status: Shana (official NIOC news), Tehran Times (English), Hamshahri Online and Mizan (independent Iranian outlets). Owner support cited via Tehran Times/Shana (NIGC under Oil Ministry); per project convention owner/operator refs belong on the operators/owners tab. NOT filled (no reliable figure, not fabricated): Capacity, Diameter, ProposalYear, ProjectLevelCost. ROUTE: no official GIS found; RouteType/RouteAccuracy left blank pending routes-repo work; corridor Iranshahr-Makran-Konarak-Chabahar. All 4 cited URLs passed scripts/url_verifier.py.
